title: admin_actions
description: A service declares the admin operations it supports, in its own /internal/manifest, under an `admin_actions` array. The platform admin panel aggregates these across every service. THE PANEL IS A MAP, NEVER THE AUTHORITY: `capability` is declared only so the panel can hide a button the caller could not use; the owning service re-checks it on every call. Any service in any language that emits this shape appears in the panel automatically.

id.description: Stable, service-unique id, e.g. `tenant.suspend`. The panel keys on it.

label.description: Human text for the button. UNTRUSTED — the renderer MUST escape it (a third-party service's label is stored-XSS otherwise; see phase-33 T4).

method.description: Allow-list only. Anything else is refused by safety:admin.

path.description: A RELATIVE path on the DECLARING service. No scheme, no host, no query. The aggregator always invokes it at that service's discovered address — a declaration cannot name an arbitrary URL (SSRF; see phase-33 T2/T4).

capability.description: The capability the OWNING ROUTE already enforces. Declared so the panel filters what it shows; never a substitute for the server-side check.

params.description: Form fields. Become inputs in the panel.

confirm.description: The renderer requires an explicit re-confirm before submitting. UX only.

danger.description: Destructive/irreversible. Rendered distinctly and implies confirm. UX only — the server still enforces the capability.

group.description: Optional section label for grouping actions in the panel.
